verdicts.reason: A scrambles the message to 'MAKEUP TRAVEL KIT', and its KIT box is far too large and runs off the top edge. Its background also has visible tiled seams, with the brushes and powder cropped into meaningless slivers. B keeps the correct 'TRAVEL MAKEUP KIT' order, but KIT has lost its white box and butts against the MAKEUP box, while the empty box sits orphaned in the bottom-right corner. B shares the seamed, patchy background and stacks its boxes edge to edge with no gutters, but it is still the less broken of the two.
